Which shortwave radio stations are on air now?

As of Tuesday, October 6, 2026, 12:01 UTC, 181 shortwave stations are scheduled to be on the air, including 4DX Radio, Alcaravan Radio, Auckland Radio, BBC. The table at the top of this page lists them with frequency, language and target area.

How do I find a shortwave station's schedule and frequency?

Open any station page from the A–Z list below. Each page shows that station's frequencies, broadcast times in UTC, languages and target areas from the A-26 schedule.

Can I listen to these stations without a radio?

Yes. Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser — see our Listen Online page for links and tuning steps.
